title: A Toast to Barcelona! 🍷
text: James was very knowledgeable about the six wines we tried during our rooftop tasting.  He was also very personable and open to sharing local insights about Barcelona.  The wines we tried were a good variety and definitely something for everyone.  Wre booked last minute (the day before) and got really lucky with James as our guide and the tastings.
author: Jocelyn_D

title: Great Experience
text: We had a wonderful experience. James was super knowledgeable and shared lots of new things we hadn’t known about wine. They provided some snacks as well. We would highly recommend.

title: Lads Trip Wine Tasting
text:
A great wine tasting experience - the wine was lovely and Eva was an amazing guide, giving us an in depth experience on Spanish wines.

The cost is 100% worth it for the wine and snacks provided and the experience as a whole was perfect - we would definitely recommend this to anyone who enjoys wine and wants to learn the background of Spanish wines.
